package rulefixtures

import (
	"testing"
)

// scenario for table_driven_tests_mix_multiple_domains_in_one_cases_slice: Oversized case tables that mix unrelated behaviors into one monolithic test.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
func TestMixedDomainCases(t *testing.T) {
	type testCase struct {
		name      string
		userID    int
		orderID   int
		paymentID int
		wantError bool
		wantMsg   string
	}
	cases := []testCase{
		{name: "create user", userID: 1, wantError: false, wantMsg: "user created"},
		{name: "ship order", orderID: 100, wantError: false, wantMsg: "order shipped"},
		{name: "refund payment", paymentID: 500, wantError: true, wantMsg: "insufficient funds"},
		{name: "delete user with open orders", userID: 2, orderID: 200, wantError: true, wantMsg: "orders still open"},
	}
	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			_ = tc.wantError
			_ = tc.wantMsg
		})
	}
}
